inputs.name: Integral lattice and discriminant of a number field
inputs.accepted_statement: The ring of integers is free of rank [L:Q]; its Minkowski embedding is a full lattice of covolume 2^(-r_2) sqrt(|disc L|). Nonzero algebraic integers have nonzero integral norms.
inputs.author: J. S. Milne
inputs.title: Algebraic Number Theory
inputs.theorem_reference: Proposition 4.26 and its integral-basis proof; elementary integral-basis and norm facts from Chapter 2.
inputs.specialization: L is the original totally complex field. The product lattice is O_L^N, degree d=nN, with no field or discriminant change.

proved_here_instead_of_retained_as_input: Minkowski convex-body argument used for positivity and the Gram determinant bound

Equivariant homology torsion bound with all stabilizer primes retained

Principal congruence kernel at 3 is torsion-free
All orbit and near-vector constants and power absorption
standard_background: Free resolutions and first-quadrant double-complex filtrations
Smith normal form, saturation, Hadamard and Cauchy--Schwarz
Singular subdivision and its prism homotopy
not_assumed: Any source Good, Acyc, orb, stab, TorsBound or TorsBoundPow predicate
